marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major US tech hardware and cloud providers reported increased capital expenditure guidance for AI server build-outs, driving chipmaker shares up in pre-market trading.
marketLayer.inference: High CapEx commitments suggest sustained near-term demand across the semiconductor supply chain, bolstering underlying earnings support for the Nasdaq.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization timelines for corporate end-users adopting enterprise AI tools remain extended.

marketLayer.title: HK Platform Economy & Internet Stocks
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index saw substantial Southbound capital net inflows as key internet giants announced expanded share repurchase programs following Q2 operational updates.
marketLayer.inference: Accelerated share buybacks and steady user engagement figures are creating a firm valuation floor for major Chinese tech platforms.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Domestic consumer spending momentum and potential post-summer price competition in e-commerce.

marketLayer.title: Global Macro & Interest Rate Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: US wholesale inflation data came in softer than expected, leading swap markets to price in a higher probability of a Federal Reserve rate cut at the upcoming FOMC meeting.
marketLayer.inference: A easing global rate cycle reduces capital outflow pressures on Hong Kong equities and supports interest-rate sensitive sectors like HK REITs and property developers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential volatility in global commodity prices impacting the trajectory of core inflation.
